title: Phonics Program for Schools in India
text: Tiny Steps offers a research-aligned phonics partnership for schools in India and internationally. Many schools have an English curriculum but not one protected, systematic, cumulative phonics sequence across classrooms. General teaching experience and fluent English do not automatically provide specialist knowledge of phonemic awareness, sound-symbol mapping, blending, segmenting, decoding, encoding, spelling patterns, error diagnosis, and reteaching. The school's existing teachers deliver the program after live Tiny Steps training, rehearsal, and coaching. The partnership includes a sequenced curriculum, teacher-led digital lesson decks, interactive listening, tracing, blending, word-building and spelling games, printable practice, assessment guidance, and support throughout the academic year. Games reinforce explicit teaching rather than replace it. Founding-school pricing is ₹59,000 plus GST per campus for a focused annual licence and ₹99,000 plus GST per campus for the whole-school partnership. Multi-campus plans start from ₹1.75 lakh plus GST. An eight-week pilot for one grade, up to four teachers, and up to 60 learners costs ₹24,900 plus GST and can be credited toward annual adoption when upgraded within 30 days.

title: Curriculum Overview
text: The Tiny Steps curriculum builds reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills. Phonics covers sounds, blending, decoding, and early reading. Grammar covers sentence formation, tense accuracy, punctuation, and writing. Public Speaking develops confidence, storytelling, pronunciation, and presentation skills. One free 35-minute demo assessment class helps determine the correct starting stage.
